locations.label: Stage power switch
locations.description: From the lobby, buy the upstairs route through the rooms, Speed Cola area and Dressing Room to the stage, or take the lower Alley route around the other side. Switch on power at the side of the stage to lift the curtain and open the central theatre loop. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Stage teleporter
locations.description: Interact with the teleporter pad on the stage to begin a link. Run to the circular mainframe pad in the lobby and interact again to finish it. Gather everyone who wants to upgrade inside the stage teleporter before activating it. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: The teleporter sends its occupants to the projection booth for about 30 seconds. Pack-a-Punch costs 5,000 points. Retrieve your gun before the forced return; the clock over the machine shows the remaining window. A random intermission room may appear before you return to the lobby. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Quick Revive
locations.description: Jugger-Nog is beside the theatre’s rear seating; Quick Revive is in the lobby, Speed Cola on the upper indoor route and Double Tap in the Alley. In solo, Quick Revive provides up to three self-revives. Updated BO1 also adds Mule Kick, but no Wunderfizz. Double Tap is the original fire-rate version. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
